pinyin: xìng xiāng jìn, xí xiāng yuǎn
literal: nature · mutually · close, habit · mutually · far
natural: by nature people are alike; by habit they grow far apart

meaning.en: People are born much alike; upbringing, habits and education make them different.
meaning.zh: 人的天性相近，后天的习惯和教育使人差别很大。

examples.zh: “性相近，习相远”，环境对孩子的影响很大。
examples.en: '{}': environment greatly affects children.

examples.zh: 老师用“性相近，习相远”鼓励学生养成好习惯。
examples.en: The teacher used '{}' to encourage good habits.

story.en: In the Three Character Classic this line follows 'at the beginning people are by nature good'; it echoes Confucius in the Analects, chapter 'Yang Huo'.
story.zh: 《三字经》紧接“人之初，性本善”；此语源自《论语·阳货》中孔子之言。

usage.en: In the 《三字经》 it follows 人之初，性本善; the saying originates in the Analects (阳货).
usage.zh: 《三字经》中接“人之初，性本善”，语本《论语·阳货》。

text: 天行健，君子以自强不息
pinyin: tiān xíng jiàn, jūn zǐ yǐ zì qiáng bù xī
literal: Heaven · moves · strong, gentleman · accordingly · self · strengthen · not · cease
natural: Heaven's movement is strong; the gentleman accordingly strives ceaselessly to improve himself

meaning.en: Follow the tireless strength of Heaven by constantly striving to better yourself.
meaning.zh: 天道运行刚健，君子应像天一样自强不息。

examples.zh: 清华大学校训就是“天行健，君子以自强不息”的前半。
examples.en: Tsinghua University's motto draws on the first half of '{}'.

examples.zh: 运动员用“天行健，君子以自强不息”激励自己。
examples.en: The athlete encourages herself with '{}'.

story.en: From the Image commentary (大象) on the Qian hexagram of the Book of Changes, which is made of six solid lines symbolising Heaven.
story.zh: 出自《周易·乾卦》的《大象传》，乾卦六爻皆阳，象征天。

usage.en: Pairs with 地势坤，君子以厚德载物; 自强不息 is the commonly quoted part.
usage.zh: 与“地势坤，君子以厚德载物”成对；“自强不息”最常引用。

text: 地势坤，君子以厚德载物
pinyin: dì shì kūn, jūn zǐ yǐ hòu dé zài wù
literal: Earth · force · Kun, gentleman · accordingly · thick · virtue · carry · things
natural: the Earth's nature is receptive; the gentleman accordingly carries all things with great virtue

meaning.en: Be broad-minded and generous like the earth, bearing everything with great virtue.
meaning.zh: 大地的气势厚实和顺，君子应增厚品德，容载万物。

equivalents: generous and tolerant as the earth

examples.zh: 清华校训“自强不息，地势坤，君子以厚德载物”引人深思。
examples.en: Tsinghua's motto, 'self-strengthening and ... {}', is thought-provoking.

examples.zh: 他把“地势坤，君子以厚德载物”挂在会议室里。
examples.en: He hangs '{}' in the meeting room.

story.en: From the Image commentary on the Kun hexagram, made of six broken lines and standing for Earth.
story.zh: 出自《周易·坤卦》的《大象传》，坤卦六爻皆阴，象征地。

usage.en: Pairs with 天行健，君子以自强不息.
usage.zh: 与“天行健，君子以自强不息”成对。

pinyin: shēng yú yōu huàn, sǐ yú ān lè
literal: live · in · worry · hardship, die · in · ease · comfort
natural: we survive in adversity and perish in comfort

meaning.en: Hardship and a sense of danger keep us strong; ease and complacency lead to ruin.
meaning.zh: 忧患使人奋发生存，安逸享乐使人衰败灭亡。

equivalents: adversity breeds strength, comfort breeds decay

examples.zh: “生于忧患，死于安乐”，企业越成功越要有危机感。
examples.en: '{}': the more successful a firm is, the more it needs a sense of crisis.

examples.zh: 他用“生于忧患，死于安乐”提醒自己别松懈。
examples.en: He used '{}' to remind himself not to slacken.

story.en: Mencius argues that Heaven tests those it will entrust with a great task, and that states without external threats tend to perish.
story.zh: 孟子论证：上天要把重任交给某人，必先使其受尽磨难；国家没有外患，往往灭亡。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

pinyin: qīng, qǔ zhī yú lán, ér qīng yú lán
literal: blue-green, take · it · from · indigo, yet · bluer · than · indigo
natural: blue is extracted from the indigo plant, yet is bluer than indigo

meaning.en: A student can surpass the teacher through learning, as dye is stronger than its source.
meaning.zh: 靛青取自蓝草，却比蓝草更青；比喻学生超过老师，后人胜过前人。

examples.zh: 师傅笑着说：“青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝”，你已经比我强了。
examples.en: The master smiled: '{}'; you are already better than I am.

examples.zh: “青，取之于蓝，而青于蓝”，新一代科学家成长很快。
examples.en: '{}': a new generation of scientists is growing fast.

story.en: The opening of Xunzi's 'Encouraging Learning': study never ends, and the learner can exceed the teacher, as indigo dye exceeds the plant.
story.zh: 《荀子·劝学》开篇：学不可以已，学习者可以超过老师，如同青胜于蓝。

usage.en: Often shortened to 青出于蓝 (an entry of its own) or 青出于蓝而胜于蓝.
usage.zh: 常缩为“青出于蓝”，亦作“青出于蓝而胜于蓝”。

text: 不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海
pinyin: bù jī kuǐ bù, wú yǐ zhì qiān lǐ, bù jī xiǎo liú, wú yǐ chéng jiāng hǎi
literal: not · accumulate · half-steps · steps, no · means · reach · thousand · li, not · accumulate · small · streams, no · means · form · rivers · seas
natural: without accumulating half-steps you cannot travel a thousand li; without gathering small streams you cannot form rivers and seas

meaning.en: Great achievements are built up from small, steady steps.
meaning.zh: 不积累一步步的小进展，就无法走到千里之外；不汇集细流，就无法形成江海。

equivalents: a journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step
many a little makes a mickle

examples.zh: 背单词要天天坚持，“不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海”。
examples.en: Keep learning words every day: '{}'.

examples.zh: 老师引用“不积跬步，无以至千里；不积小流，无以成江海”鼓励大家一点一滴积累。
examples.en: The teacher quoted '{}' to urge steady accumulation.

story.en: Xunzi illustrates the value of persistent effort with the image of piling up earth to form a mountain and gathering streams to form a sea.
story.zh: 荀子用积土成山、积水成渊的比喻，说明持之以恒的重要。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛
pinyin: rén gù yǒu yī sǐ, huò zhòng yú tài shān, huò qīng yú hóng máo
literal: people · surely · have · one · death, some · heavier · than · Mount Tai, some · lighter · than · swan-goose · feather
natural: everyone must die once; some deaths are weightier than Mount Tai, others lighter than a goose feather

meaning.en: The value of a death depends on what it is for.
meaning.zh: 人总有一死，死的意义有轻有重，取决于是否有价值。

equivalents: it's what you die for that counts

examples.zh: 毛泽东在《为人民服务》中引用了“人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛”。
examples.en: Mao Zedong quoted '{}' in 'Serve the People'.

examples.zh: 烈士的牺牲，是“人固有一死，或重于泰山，或轻于鸿毛”中的“重于泰山”。
examples.en: The martyr's sacrifice is the 'weightier than Mount Tai' of '{}'.

story.en: Sima Qian, who chose to endure castration rather than die so he could finish the Records of the Grand Historian, explained his choice in this letter to Ren An.
story.zh: 司马迁因李陵之祸受宫刑，忍辱完成《史记》，在《报任安书》中说明生死抉择。

usage.en: Often shortened to 重于泰山 / 轻于鸿毛.
usage.zh: 常缩为“重于泰山”“轻于鸿毛”。

pinyin: guān guān jū jiū, zài hé zhī zhōu
literal: guan · guan · osprey, on · river · of · islet
natural: the ospreys call guan-guan on the river islet

meaning.en: The famous opening of the Book of Songs, a courtship scene often quoted of romance and marriage.
meaning.zh: 《诗经》首篇开头，雎鸠鸣叫于河洲之上，引出对美好爱情的歌咏。

equivalents: the opening of the Book of Songs

examples.zh: 婚礼上有人念起“关关雎鸠，在河之洲”。
examples.en: At the wedding someone recited '{}'.

examples.zh: 《诗经》第一首就是“关关雎鸠，在河之洲”。
examples.en: The first poem of the Book of Songs begins with '{}'.

story.en: The opening poem of the Book of Songs, in which a gentleman longs for a good girl he glimpsed gathering water plants.
story.zh: 《诗经》第一篇，写君子追求河边采荇菜的淑女。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

pinyin: jiān jiā cāng cāng, bái lù wéi shuāng
literal: reeds · rushes · green-grey · green-grey, white · dew · become · frost
natural: the reeds are green-grey and the white dew has turned to frost

meaning.en: A misty autumn scene opening a poem of longing for a person just out of reach.
meaning.zh: 芦苇苍苍，白露结霜；开启对心上人可望而不可即的怀念。

equivalents: longing for someone out of reach

examples.zh: 读到“蒹葭苍苍，白露为霜”，仿佛看到秋天的河岸。
examples.en: Reading '{}', one seems to see the autumn riverbank.

examples.zh: 这首歌的歌词化用了“蒹葭苍苍，白露为霜”。
examples.en: The song's lyrics adapt '{}'.

story.en: A Qin folk song about seeking someone who is always on the other side of the water.
story.zh: 秦地民歌，写追寻伊人而不得的怅惘。

usage.en: Often followed by 所谓伊人，在水一方 (the one I seek is on the other side of the water).
usage.zh: 常接“所谓伊人，在水一方”。

pinyin: zhí zǐ zhī shǒu, yǔ zǐ xié lǎo
literal: hold · you · of · hand, with · you · together · grow old
natural: I take your hand, and will grow old with you

meaning.en: A vow of lifelong devotion between lovers or spouses.
meaning.zh: 握住你的手，与你一起白头到老；常用作婚誓与爱情誓言。

examples.zh: 婚礼誓词是“执子之手，与子偕老”。
examples.en: The wedding vow is '{}'.

examples.zh: 金婚纪念日，他们写下“执子之手，与子偕老”。
examples.en: On their golden anniversary they wrote '{}'.

story.en: In the original poem a soldier recalls the vow he made to his wife before leaving for war; later it became a wedding vow.
story.zh: 原诗写征人回忆出征前与妻子的誓约，后世多用作婚誓。

usage.en: Used as a wedding blessing.
usage.zh: 常用作婚礼祝福。

text: 昔我往矣，杨柳依依；今我来思，雨雪霏霏
pinyin: xī wǒ wǎng yǐ, yáng liǔ yī yī, jīn wǒ lái sī, yù xuě fēi fēi
literal: past · I · went · particle, willow · willow · swaying, now · I · come · particle, rain · snow · falling · thickly
natural: when I left, the willows were swaying; now I return, and the snow falls thick

meaning.en: A moving contrast of the past and present, joined to the soldier's hardships.
meaning.zh: 出征时杨柳依依，归来时雨雪纷飞；以景写情，今昔对比，感慨深沉。

equivalents: then spring willows, now falling snow

examples.zh: 老兵回乡时，想起“昔我往矣，杨柳依依；今我来思，雨雪霏霏”。
examples.en: The old soldier thought of '{}' as he returned home.

examples.zh: 王夫之说“昔我往矣，杨柳依依；今我来思，雨雪霏霏”是古今最佳写景之一。
examples.en: Wang Fuzhi called '{}' one of the best scenic couplets of all time.

story.en: A soldier on the frontier laments his long years of campaigning and his weary return.
story.zh: 戍边士兵感慨长年征战，归途艰难。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

pinyin: tā shān zhī shí, kě yǐ gōng yù
literal: other · mountain · of · stones, can · use · cut · jade
natural: stones from other hills can be used to polish jade

meaning.en: Learn from others, even from outside, to improve yourself.
meaning.zh: 别处山上的石头可以用来琢磨玉器；比喻借鉴外部的意见或经验改进自己。

examples.zh: 公司派员工出国考察，“他山之石，可以攻玉”。
examples.en: The company sent staff abroad to learn: '{}'.

examples.zh: “他山之石，可以攻玉”，引进国外技术并不丢人。
examples.en: '{}': there is no shame in importing foreign technology.

story.en: The Book of Songs poem 'Crane's Cry' uses the image of stones from other hills to polish jade, taken to mean that even lesser things can help.
story.zh: 《诗经·鹤鸣》以他山之石可以磨玉，比喻外来的东西也能助益自己。

usage.en: Often written 他山之石可以攻玉 without comma; the saying is also a chengyu-like unit.
usage.zh: 常写作“他山之石可以攻玉”。

pinyin: zhāo wén dào, xī sǐ kě yǐ
literal: morning · hear · the Way, evening · die · may · particle
natural: if I hear the Way in the morning, I may die content that evening

meaning.en: Understanding truth is so precious that one could die without regret afterwards.
meaning.zh: 早上懂得了真理，晚上死去也值得；表示追求真理的迫切。

equivalents: a seeker's devotion to the truth

examples.zh: 他说“朝闻道，夕死可矣”，一心钻研学问。
examples.en: He says '{}' and devotes himself to scholarship.

examples.zh: 老教授常引用“朝闻道，夕死可矣”勉励学生。
examples.en: The old professor often quotes '{}' to encourage students.

story.en: Confucius expresses the supreme value of grasping the Way (dao).
story.zh: 孔子表达对“道”的追求高于一切。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

text: 君子和而不同，小人同而不和
pinyin: jūn zǐ hé ér bù tóng, xiǎo rén tóng ér bù hé
literal: gentleman · harmonise · yet · not · conform, petty man · conform · yet · not · harmonise
natural: the gentleman seeks harmony without uniformity; the petty man seeks uniformity without harmony

meaning.en: A good person works in harmony with others while keeping their own views.
meaning.zh: 君子能与人和谐相处而不盲从，小人盲从附和却不能真正和睦。

examples.zh: 团队合作需要“君子和而不同，小人同而不和”。
examples.en: Teamwork needs '{}'.

examples.zh: 国际交往中，各国应“君子和而不同，小人同而不和”。
examples.en: In international relations, countries should keep to '{}'.

story.en: Confucius distinguishes the gentleman who respects differences from the petty man who merely follows others.
story.zh: 孔子区分君子的求同存异与小人的盲目附和。

usage.en: Often quoted as 和而不同, especially in diplomacy.
usage.zh: 常缩为“和而不同”，多用于外交场合。

text: 三军可夺帅也，匹夫不可夺志也
pinyin: sān jūn kě duó shuài yě, pǐ fū bù kě duó zhì yě
literal: three · armies · can · seize · commander · particle, common · man · cannot · seize · will · particle
natural: the commander of three armies may be taken, but even a common man's will cannot be taken

meaning.en: A person's determination cannot be forced away by anyone.
meaning.zh: 军队的主帅可以被夺走，普通人的志向却不能被夺走；形容意志坚定。

equivalents: you can't break a determined man

examples.zh: 面对压力，他说“三军可夺帅也，匹夫不可夺志也”。
examples.en: Under pressure he said '{}'.

examples.zh: “三军可夺帅也，匹夫不可夺志也”，她坚持自己的理想。
examples.en: '{}': she held to her ideals.

story.en: Confucius contrasts the vulnerability of a great army's leader with the unconquerable will of the humblest person.
story.zh: 孔子以三军之帅与匹夫之志相比，强调意志之不可夺。

usage.en: Often shortened to 匹夫不可夺志.
usage.zh: 常缩为“匹夫不可夺志”。

text: 岁寒，然后知松柏之后凋也
pinyin: suì hán, rán hòu zhī sōng bǎi zhī hòu diāo yě
literal: year · cold, then · know · pine · cypress · of · later · wither · particle
natural: only when the year turns cold do we know that pine and cypress are the last to wither

meaning.en: True character is revealed only in hard times.
meaning.zh: 到了严寒季节，才知道松柏最后凋谢；比喻困难时才见人的品格。

equivalents: a friend in need is a friend indeed

examples.zh: “岁寒，然后知松柏之后凋也”，患难时才看出谁是真朋友。
examples.en: '{}': hardship shows who a real friend is.

examples.zh: 他选择留在公司，“岁寒，然后知松柏之后凋也”。
examples.en: He chose to stay with the company: '{}'.

story.en: Confucius uses the evergreens that survive winter as an image of the gentleman's integrity in adversity.
story.zh: 孔子以松柏耐寒比喻君子在逆境中的节操。

usage.en: Often cut to 岁寒松柏 or 岁寒知松柏.
usage.zh: 常缩为“岁寒知松柏”。

pinyin: shì zhě rú sī fū, bù shě zhòu yè
literal: that which · passes · like · this · particle, not · cease · day · night
natural: that which passes is like this river, flowing day and night without pause

meaning.en: Time flows on ceaselessly like a river, so cherish it.
meaning.zh: 流逝的时光就像这河水一样，日夜不停；感叹时间飞逝，应珍惜光阴。

equivalents: time and tide wait for no man

examples.zh: 站在河边，他感叹“逝者如斯夫，不舍昼夜”。
examples.en: Standing by the river he sighed '{}'.

examples.zh: 新年致辞里引用了“逝者如斯夫，不舍昼夜”。
examples.en: The New Year address quoted '{}'.

story.en: Standing on a riverbank, Confucius sighed at the ceaseless passing of time.
story.zh: 孔子站在河边，感叹时间如流水般不停逝去。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

pinyin: kè jǐ fù lǐ wéi rén
literal: overcome · self · return · ritual · be · humaneness
natural: to restrain oneself and return to ritual propriety is humaneness

meaning.en: True humaneness lies in disciplining oneself to follow proper conduct.
meaning.zh: 约束自己，使言行合乎礼，就是仁。

examples.zh: 孔子对颜渊说：“克己复礼为仁”。
examples.en: Confucius told Yan Yuan: '{}'.

examples.zh: 读《论语》，要理解“克己复礼为仁”的含义。
examples.en: In reading the Analects one must understand the meaning of '{}'.

story.en: Yan Yuan asked about humaneness (ren), and Confucius answered with this phrase.
story.zh: 颜渊问仁，孔子以此作答。

usage.en: Philosophical; read in context of Confucian ethics.
usage.zh: 哲理性强，需结合儒家伦理理解。

text: 非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动
pinyin: fēi lǐ wù shì, fēi lǐ wù tīng, fēi lǐ wù yán, fēi lǐ wù dòng
literal: not · ritual · don't · look, not · ritual · don't · listen, not · ritual · don't · speak, not · ritual · don't · move
natural: do not look at what is improper, do not listen to what is improper, do not say what is improper, do not do what is improper

meaning.en: Keep one's eyes, ears, mouth and actions within the bounds of propriety.
meaning.zh: 不合礼的不看、不听、不说、不做；约束自己的言行。

equivalents: see no evil, hear no evil, speak no evil

examples.zh: 家训写着“非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动”。
examples.en: The family precept reads '{}'.

examples.zh: 他自律严格，“非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动”。
examples.en: He is strictly self-disciplined: '{}'.

story.en: Confucius's reply when Yan Yuan asked about the practical steps to humaneness.
story.zh: 颜渊请问实践“仁”的具体条目，孔子以此作答。

usage.en: Often shortened to 非礼勿视 etc.; the 'four don'ts'.
usage.zh: 常拆为“非礼勿视”等，称“四勿”。

pinyin: sì hǎi zhī nèi, jiē xiōng dì yě
literal: four · seas · of · within, all · brothers · particle
natural: within the four seas, all are brothers

meaning.en: All people are like family, regardless of where they are from.
meaning.zh: 天下的人都像兄弟一样；表达友爱与团结。

examples.zh: 国际友人间，“四海之内，皆兄弟也”。
examples.en: Among friends from around the world, '{}'.

examples.zh: 外出旅游遇到热情的路人，他感叹“四海之内，皆兄弟也”。
examples.en: Meeting kind strangers while travelling, he sighed '{}'.

story.en: Confucius's disciple Zixia consoled Sima Niu, who lamented that he had no brothers, with this line.
story.zh: 司马牛感叹自己没有兄弟，子夏以此宽慰他。

usage.en: Often paired with 君子敬而无失，与人恭而有礼.
usage.zh: 上文为“君子敬而无失，与人恭而有礼”。

pinyin: mín wú xìn bù lì
literal: people · without · trust · not · stand
natural: without trust, the people cannot stand

meaning.en: A state, organisation or person cannot survive without credibility.
meaning.zh: 没有信任，国家、组织或个人就无法立足。

examples.zh: 政府政策要言而有信，“民无信不立”。
examples.en: Government policy must be reliable: '{}'.

examples.zh: 做生意讲究诚信，“民无信不立”。
examples.en: In business, honesty matters: '{}'.

story.en: Confucius told Zigong that, of food, arms and trust, trust is the last that a ruler should give up.
story.zh: 子贡问政，孔子说粮食、军备、信任三者中，信任最不可舍弃。

usage.en: Often quoted in the form 民无信不立 or 人无信不立.
usage.zh: 常引作“民无信不立”，也说“人无信不立”。

text: 君子成人之美，不成人之恶
pinyin: jūn zǐ chéng rén zhī měi, bù chéng rén zhī è
literal: gentleman · complete · others · of · good, not · complete · others · of · evil
natural: the gentleman helps others achieve what is good, and does not help them do what is bad

meaning.en: A good person helps others achieve worthy aims and refuses to aid bad ones.
meaning.zh: 君子帮助别人成就好事，不助长别人的坏事。

equivalents: help others succeed in good things

examples.zh: 导师一向“君子成人之美，不成人之恶”，常帮学生推荐机会。
examples.en: The mentor always lives by '{}', often recommending opportunities for students.

examples.zh: “君子成人之美，不成人之恶”，他拒绝帮朋友作弊。
examples.en: '{}': he refused to help a friend cheat.

story.en: Confucius contrasts how a gentleman treats others' good and bad intentions with the petty man.
story.zh: 孔子以此区分君子与小人对待他人好坏的态度。

usage.en: Often shortened to 成人之美, a chengyu in its own right.
usage.zh: 常缩为“成人之美”。

pinyin: dào bù tóng, bù xiāng wéi móu
literal: way · not · same, not · mutually · for · plan
natural: those who follow different paths cannot plan together

meaning.en: People with different principles or goals cannot work together.
meaning.zh: 主张或志向不同的人无法一起共事。

equivalents: can't work together with different goals

examples.zh: 两人理念不合，“道不同，不相为谋”，只好分开。
examples.en: They disagreed on principles: '{}', so they went separate ways.

examples.zh: “道不同，不相为谋”，合伙人最终拆伙。
examples.en: '{}': the partners finally dissolved the partnership.

story.en: Confucius says that people with different ways cannot make plans together.
story.zh: 孔子说主张不同的人不能共同谋划。

usage.en: Quotation; usually cited whole or in its first half, in speeches, essays and captions.
usage.zh: 引语，多整句或引上半句，用于演讲、作文和配文。

pinyin: dāng rén, bù ràng yú shī
literal: face · humaneness, not · yield · to · teacher
natural: when it comes to humaneness, do not yield even to your teacher

meaning.en: In doing what is right, do not defer even to your teacher.
meaning.zh: 在应当做的事情上，即使面对老师也不必谦让。

equivalents: do right even over your master's objections

examples.zh: “当仁，不让于师”，真理面前人人平等。
examples.en: '{}': everyone is equal before the truth.

examples.zh: 导师鼓励学生“当仁，不让于师”，大胆质疑。
examples.en: The supervisor encouraged students, '{}', to question boldly.

story.en: Confucius says that on matters of humaneness one need not defer even to one's teacher.
story.zh: 孔子说在实践仁义上，即使对老师也不必谦让。

usage.en: The origin of 当仁不让; the full line is 当仁，不让于师.
usage.zh: 成语“当仁不让”即出于此。

pinyin: xué ér bù yàn, huì rén bù juàn
literal: learn · and · not · tire, teach · people · not · weary
natural: to learn without tiring and teach others without weariness

meaning.en: Insatiable in studying, tireless in teaching; the ideal of a teacher.
meaning.zh: 自己学习不满足，教导别人不厌倦；形容教师的理想品质。

examples.zh: 老师一生“学而不厌，诲人不倦”，深受学生爱戴。
examples.en: The teacher spent his life '{}' and was beloved by students.

examples.zh: 教师节，学生送上“学而不厌，诲人不倦”的锦旗。
examples.en: On Teachers' Day, students gave a banner reading '{}'.

story.en: Confucius says that he does these things naturally; the full line ends 何有于我哉.
story.zh: 孔子自谦说这些他都做到了；下句为“何有于我哉”。

usage.en: Often used in praise of teachers, especially in the form 诲人不倦.
usage.zh: 多用来赞美教师，常说“诲人不倦”。
